caption: The drawing features a single metallic object resembling a circular tin or pan with a central cylindrical tube extending vertically from the middle of the base to just above the rim; the tube is hollow, as indicated by visible openings at the top and bottom. The main body of the object is shallow and round, and a double-bar handle is attached perpendicularly to one side, extending leftward and terminating in a slightly rounded end. The illustration is rendered in shades of black, gray, and white on a plain, off-white background with subtle signs of aging or discoloration visible along the edges. There is a small artist's signature in the lower left quadrant of the image. No other objects or decorative elements are present in the composition.
title: Candlestick
